releases.notes:
# Additions

## Blocks
* Rafter and Rafter Ends for all wood types.
* Red Floor Tile block set.
* Loong Tuanhua and Glazed Central Wall Pattern blocks, can be placed on all faces, direction can be changed with wooden mallet when on top or bottom.
* Grass Lucky Motif blocks, 3 variants, can be placed on block side.
* Yellow Green Top Layer Eaves, can be placed on block side.
* Lotus Leaves Bowl, can be filled with Water Bucket and emptied with Bucket.

## Gameplay
* Fur now drop from Fox, Rabbit and Goat.
* Raw Meat now drop from Hoglin and Ravager.
* New Cooked Meat recipe from Raw Meat.

# Changes

## Guide Book
* Guide Book now has new item texture and GUI texture.
* Updated entries in Guide Book

## Texture
* Updated texture of Dark Oak Rafter and Rafter End to match newly added ones.

## Compat
* Recipes that use bronze now accept c:ingots/bronze
* Cobalt dust now can be made with items with c:ingots/cobalt tag
* Recipes that use Silk now accept ultramarine:silk
* Recipes that use Xuan Paper now accept ultramarine:xuan_paper, with support for SinoBrush Silk item.
* Recipes that use Baozi now accept ultramarine:baozi, with support for Farmer's Delight, Youkai's Homecoming and Kaleidoscope Cookery.
* Recipes that use Cooked Meat now accept ultramarine:ham, with support for Farmer's Delight.

# Fixes
* Fixed Ebony Bed having wrong occlusion setting.
* Fixed z-fighting on some models.
* Fixed some blocks having extra cubes on models.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LocusAzzurro/Ultramarine/compare/0.6.7...0.7.0

* Added support for Structure Block rotation and mirroring logic.

### Additions

- Ebony Bed

- Jade Blocks can now be used as Beacon base block.
- Changed texture of Bronze Block to be more similar to vanilla Copper Block.
